answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations generate rate-limit proofs. Each message carries an RLN nullifier, binding the proof to that identity and epoch. Reusing it beyond the limit exposes distinct Shamir shares; interpolation recovers the registered secret key, enabling verifiable, immediate slashing of bonded collateral. The vertex checks this evidence, while knoll and nadir mark epoch boundaries for commitment rotation.
